connector.name: Voicemode
connector.registryDescription: Natural voice conversations for AI assistants - STT/TTS via MCP
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package voice-mode. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.voicemode. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for cloud-based STT/TTS (optional - local services can be installed)

env.name: VOICEMODE_DEBUG
env.description: Enable debug mode with detailed logging (true/false)

env.name: VOICEMODE_SKIP_TTS
env.description: Skip TTS and show text only for faster response (true/false)

env.name: VOICEMODE_PREFER_LOCAL
env.description: Prefer local services over cloud when available (true/false, default: true)

env.name: VOICEMODE_AUDIO_FORMAT
env.description: Audio format: pcm, mp3, wav, flac, aac, opus (default: pcm)

env.name: VOICEMODE_WHISPER_MODEL
env.description: Whisper model: tiny, base, small, medium, large (default: base)

env.name: VOICEMODE_DISABLE_SILENCE_DETECTION
env.description: Disable silence detection for continuous recording (true/false)
